item.description:
New in this build — please update CamBridge Camera on your iPhone too:

• Dim iPhone now: a new button (top bar and side panel) darkens your iPhone screen immediately while recording and the live view keep running — saves battery and keeps the phone cooler. Tap the phone to wake it.

• Mirror live view: new switch in the side panel flips the live view on your Mac like a mirror. Recordings are never mirrored, and click-to-focus still lands where you click.

• Settings are now grouped (Live view, Video, Photo, Exposure & focus, Audio, iPhone power, Advanced) with collapsible sections and a search box at the top. The gear button now opens this panel, and Footage folder + Diagnostics moved into it under "This Mac" (usable even without an iPhone connected) — type e.g. "fps", "mirror" or "battery".

• Small windows: the connection pill and lens/zoom bar now fit narrow windows instead of wrapping text letter by letter.

• Update reminders: CamBridge now tells you when a newer version is available (Update / Later), and confirms after you update.

• Dim / Wake toggle: the same button dims the iPhone screen and wakes it again (update CamBridge on your iPhone too).

• Double-click the top bar to zoom the window to fill the screen (follows your macOS setting), and drag it to move the window.

• Removed the stray "»" button at the top-right; Refresh now sits at the bottom of the camera list.

Crash and error reports are sent anonymously so we can fix bugs faster. Please report anything odd via TestFlight feedback.
